title: Kaleidoscope
techniques: sibling-count() and sibling-index() fold count with :nth-child fallback
fixed mirrors over a turning object cell with tumbling glass layers
endless barrel turn with coprime animation periods
per-visit random() with element-shared, keeping the mirrors symmetric
optional adaptive size: a small script fits the eyepiece to the frame rate

features.name: sibling-count() / sibling-index()
features.baseline: newly available (2026-08-18); :nth-child fallback fixed at 12 wedges

features.name: CSS random()
features.baseline: limited availability (Safari 26.2; not Chrome or Firefox, checked from knowledge, not web-features); without it the pattern starts the same each visit but still never repeats
